about: TG-66 split vectors (tg-test). Plan §2: allocate, split, charge_amount. Both A1's and W1's tests load this file. Members are made up; `members` maps each name to its id, in wallet order. Shapes follow P0's contract choices 1 and 2: inputs [{member_id, value}] (equal 1, exact centavos, percent basis points, shares 0 to 20, adjust the extra, rows = among); items [{name, price_centavos, who}] with seq = list position from 1; charges [{kind, basis, value}]. expect is {amount, shares} or {error, seq?}. Expected values come from tg-test's own reference, written from the plan, not from either implementation.
